name: Kerttu Kunnari
bio:
Kerttu Kunnari is a talented tattoo artist specializing in the vibrant and dynamic styles of neotraditional and newschool tattoos. As the co-owner of @neo.ink.co, Kerttu is known for their exceptional professionalism, consistently providing clients with a high level of service and ensuring that all interactions from inquiry to the completion of the tattoo are handled with utmost attention and care. Whether communicating via blackcaptattoo@gmail.com or in person, Kerttu maintains a standard of excellence that resonates with their clientele.
